loop.top3_why_not: Candidate C, while having the best overall score, relies on a pooled meta‑model trained on all other series. With only three validation windows the weight estimates are highly variable, and the extreme performance on the third window (2.499) indicates potential overfitting. Candidate B has a noticeably worse score and a more unstable per‑window pattern, making it less suitable. Therefore A is the safest choice for generalization to the blind test window.
